about.heading: About Me
about.title: Who Am I?
about.intro: Hey I'm Degly Pava, Senior Extended Reality Specialist and CEO in Tokyo, Japan. I've mentored 700+ developers globally, created 291M+ AR interactions, and built partnerships with MIT, KDDI, and Meta.
about.summary: Featured at MWC 2025 with Apple Vision Pro demo • Developed STYLY platform hosting 50,000+ XR experiences • Global XR community leader

detailed.paragraph1: My expertise spans cutting-edge Extended Reality experiences that have garnered attention from industry leaders across Japan, USA, and Colombia. I've worked with gaming giants like CAPCOM and Nintendo, led AR development for Universal Studios Japan, and pioneered AR glasses technology through Qualcomm's Developer Pathfinders Program.
detailed.paragraph2: Beyond XR, I've developed 2 Android applications and contributed to numerous open source projects, demonstrating versatility across mobile and web platforms. I also created a Unity package library for seamless Apple Vision Pro Spatial Persona integration, simplifying complex visionOS development workflows for the developer community.
detailed.paragraph3: From coordinating Unity-based space exploration games for Apple Vision Pro to ensuring quality standards for a €12M European XR Master's program, I bridge innovation with education.

xrTokyo.title: XRTokyo - AI/XR Glasses Talk
xrTokyo.description: Presented on the intersection of AI and XR Glasses technology at XRTokyo. Discussed emerging trends in spatial computing, AI integration in XR experiences, and the future of wearable mixed reality devices.

mwc.title: Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2025
mwc.description: Showcased Apple Vision Pro game "Astroscoop" as part of KDDI's XR innovation showcase. Demonstrated cutting-edge spatial computing and immersive gaming experiences to global audience of 100,000+ attendees.

mit.title: MIT Reality Hack & Partnerships
mit.description: Built bilateral partnerships between STYLY and MIT for XR innovation. Mentored student teams, provided technical guidance, and facilitated collaboration between academia and industry.

tgs.title: Tokyo Game Show & Global Events
tgs.description: Featured at Tokyo Game Show, SushiTech, AWE, and other major industry events. Presented on XR development, global community building, and emerging technologies to international audiences.

community.title: Developer Community Leadership
community.description: Led technical workshops across US, Korea, Latin America, and Japan. Mentored 700+ developers through hands-on training, code reviews, and career guidance in XR technologies.

styly.title: Senior Extended Reality Specialist – Manager at STYLY Inc.
styly.bullet1: Coordinated a Unity-based space exploration game demo designed for Apple Vision Pro called Astroscoop, showcased at MWC 2025 as part of KDDI's forward-looking XR initiative; contributed to STYLY's growing reputation in immersive gaming and experiences.
styly.bullet2: Led global developer outreach and bilingual partnerships for STYLY, facilitating collaboration between Japanese and international teams; built strategic relationships with MIT, Parsons School of Design, and leading XR developers across the US, Korea, and Latin America.
styly.bullet3: Drove platform growth through mentorship, technical workshops, and global event presence—supporting over 700 developers and contributing to a catalog of 50,000+ published XR contents; featured at Tokyo Game Show, MIT Reality Hack, SushiTech, AWE, and other major industry events.

erasmus.title: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist on XR, ERASMUS-IMLEX Board of Directors
erasmus.bullet1: Ensured the quality and industry relevance of a €12M XR Master's degree funded by the European Commission, supporting the development of next-gen talent in immersive technologies and game design across multiple universities.

pretia.title: Senior Unity AR Engineer, Solution Division at Pretia Technologies
pretia.bullet1: Developed core AR systems powering mobile games like ARPuzzleGame, AnimalPal, and ARgamemadeEZ, released in 173 countries and featured at Universal Studios Japan.
pretia.bullet2: Collaborated with global gaming giants including CAPCOM and Nintendo, leading cross-functional teams and managing external developers to deliver polished AR gameplay experiences.
pretia.bullet3: Pioneered AR glasses development through Qualcomm's AR Developer Pathfinders Program, focusing on multi-device collaboration, seamless UX, and high-performance mobile-to-headset interactions.

omni.title: Founder / XR Engineer at Omni Applications LLC & LucidDreams S.A.S
omni.bullet1: Created and launched high-impact AR experiences across TikTok, Instagram, and Snapchat driving over 291 million lifetime interactions and helping brands deliver immersive marketing and gaming campaigns through full-platform XR strategies.
omni.bullet2: Lead XR developer events in Colombia in collaboration with XRCol, building strong ties with the Meta Oculus Start community and supporting local creators; prototyped original game demos including an environment-reactive VR shooter built for spatial gameplay.
